feature.name: secrets-ui-enhancements
feature.summary: Filter the Secrets page app list by infrastructure target, allow bulk secret submission in one PR, and require a Jira/CR ticket on every submission.

acceptance_criteria: Selecting target=live shows only apps discovered from infrastructure-live; target=sand shows only apps from service-catalog docs/metadata/
A developer can add up to 20 secret rows, remove any row down to a minimum of one, and submit all rows as a single PR
Submission without a Jira/CR ticket matching /^[A-Za-z]+-\d+$/ is blocked client-side and rejected server-side with HTTP 400
A batch with a mid-batch encryption failure results in zero GitHub writes and an HTTP 400 response naming only the failing secretName(s)

user_stories.i_want: the app dropdown to only show apps that exist in the target repo I selected
user_stories.so_that: I don't pick an app that fails vault discovery
acceptance_criteria: Changing the target selector re-fetches and replaces the app list

user_stories.i_want: to submit multiple secrets in one action
user_stories.so_that: I don't repeat the single-secret flow 5-15 times when provisioning a new app
acceptance_criteria: Add Secret button appends a row up to a max of 20
Remove button removes a row, disabled at 1 remaining row
Duplicate secret names within the same submission are rejected before submit
On success, StatusModal shows the count of secrets submitted and the PR number

user_stories.i_want: every secret PR to reference a Jira/CR ticket
user_stories.so_that: I can correlate secret changes to approved change requests
acceptance_criteria: Jira field is required; submit is disabled when empty or malformed
PR description and commit message include the Jira ticket

errors.message: target must be live or sand
Failed to discover applications for target

request_schema.secrets: Array<{secretName: string, secretValue: string}> (1-20 entries, OR legacy singular secretName/secretValue for backward compat)

validation: both bulk-array and legacy-singular secretName fields match /^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,127}$/
no duplicate secretName within the array
validation error values for secretValue and secrets.*.secretValue are redacted from responses

errors.condition: validation failure or mid-batch encryption failure
PR already open for this branch/vault
errors.handling: surface prUrl of the existing PR to the client, matching v1 behavior; preserved unchanged for batch

errors.condition: secrets.enc.yaml changed since branch base (SHA conflict)

ui_changes: Replace single secretName/secretValue/secretConfirmation refs with secretEntries array
Add Jira/CR ticket input field (required, positioned above secret rows)
Add 'Add Secret' button (max 20 rows) and per-row 'Remove' button (min 1 row)
loadApps() calls new target-aware endpoint and re-fetches on target change

user_interactions.result: append empty row, disabled at 20 rows; aria-live region announces 'Secret row N added'
remove that row, disabled when 1 row remains; aria-live region announces 'Secret row removed, N remaining'

user_interactions.action: submit with valid entries + Jira ticket
user_interactions.result: POST /api/secrets with secrets[] + jiraTicket, StatusModal shows count + PR link

validation: target required, must be live or sand

errors.message: target must be live or sand

validation: oneOf bulk-array or legacy-singular request shape
both request shapes use secretName regex /^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,127}$/
secretValue fields are redacted from validation errors

errors.condition: PR already open for this branch/vault
errors.handling: surface prUrl of existing PR, preserved from v1

secretsEncYaml.location: {vaultDir}/secrets.enc.yaml in target repo (service-catalog for sand, infrastructure-live for live)

schema.secretName: SOPS-encrypted block per key, unchanged format from v1

validation: all keys in a batch committed in exactly one commit
no partial writes on encryption failure

flows.name: Bulk secret submission
steps: Developer adds N secret rows + Jira ticket
Client validates all rows + Jira format
Server encrypts all entries in memory
Server commits secrets.enc.yaml once and opens one PR
Client shows StatusModal with count and PR link, resets form

error_paths.handling: abort immediately, zero GitHub writes, HTTP 400 listing failing secretName(s)

error_paths.error: secrets.enc.yaml SHA changed since branch base

error_scenarios.handling: Encrypt all entries before any GitHub write; on first failure, abort with zero writes
error_scenarios.user_message: Encryption failed for: {secretName}. No changes were submitted.
error_scenarios.logging: Log failing secretName (never secretValue) with correlationId

error_scenarios.scenario: Concurrent bulk submissions to same secrets.enc.yaml
error_scenarios.handling: Existing SHA-based conflict detection returns HTTP 503
error_scenarios.user_message: Secrets file changed since you started. Please retry.

error_scenarios.scenario: infrastructure-live tree fetch fails or times out
error_scenarios.handling: Return empty app list with error surfaced to UI; do not crash
error_scenarios.user_message: Failed to load applications for the selected target.
error_scenarios.logging: Log error with correlationId and target

functional_test_scenarios.scenario: Developer submits 3 secrets in one batch with a valid Jira ticket

assertions: App list changes to infrastructure-live apps only
Previously selected app is cleared if not present in new list

edge_cases: Duplicate secretName within the same batch is rejected client- and server-side
21st secret row cannot be added (Add Secret button disabled at 20)
Adding/removing a secret row announces the change via an aria-live=polite region (non-blocking PRD Challenger Round 2 advisory, addressed proactively)
Submitting with empty Jira ticket is blocked client-side and returns 400 if bypassed
Mid-batch encryption failure results in zero GitHub writes and lists only the failing secretName

test_cases: Happy path: all secrets encrypt successfully, one commit, one PR
Error path: Nth secret fails encryption, zero createOrUpdateFileContents calls, HTTP 400
Edge case: single-secret legacy request shape preserves v1 branch naming exactly
Deterministic branch hash: names ['b','a'] use the first 8 hex characters of SHA-256 for lowercase sorted input 'a,b'
target=live extracts unique app names from cached tree
cache hit within 5 min avoids a second tree fetch

steps: Verify PR description and commit message contain Jira reference
assertions: correlationId present in response and logs
no secretValue appears in any log line

integration_tests.scenario: POST /api/secrets request-shape parity and error redaction
steps: Submit the same valid secretName through bulk-array and legacy-singular shapes
Submit a secretValue that fails validation
assertions: Both request shapes accept secretName under /^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,127}$/
Validation response contains no submitted secretValue and reports [REDACTED]

user_journey: Tab into Jira field, type ticket
Tab through name/value/confirmation of each row
Tab to Add Secret, press Enter
assertions: No mouse interaction required to complete submission
Focus order matches Jira -> row fields -> Add Secret -> Submit

security: No secretValue in logs, PR descriptions, metric payloads, or error responses (extends v1 NFR-SEC-001)
GET /api/secrets/apps and POST /api/secrets both require requireAuth
correlationId present in every response and log line
reliability: Batch submission is all-or-nothing: zero GitHub writes on any encryption failure
Existing SHA-based conflict detection (HTTP 503) unchanged for concurrent submissions
